August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 384)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on August 29 across American network radio and modern syndication, Jim French's Imagination Theater featuring private eye Harry Nile (2004) and Sherlock Holmes & Dr. Watson in School for Scoundrels (2010), Freddie Martin's big band on The Fitch Bandwagon (1943), Tommy Bartlett hosting Welcome Travelers at Chicago's Hotel Sherman for Spic and Span (1950), and Edna St. Vincent Millay's poetry on Anthology (1943–2010):
